tablet.notes:
A new sync from the phone replaces the previous one (no copies, and a sync that was replaced is not waited for).
Also since build 610: pictures show on every tablet, new groups get their own group, no doubled messages, Not sent for a text that did not go out, Blocked numbers and Muted conversations shared with the flip phone, a switch for the Connected notification, and Sync messages / Sync attachments with progress.

tablet-regular.notes:
Hold a message: the whole screen goes soft, emoji reactions sit above it and a card of actions below (Forward, Copy, Delete, Select more, Info), like Google Messages. Select more and the Details page match too.
The keyboard closes after you send and when you swipe through the messages. The voice recorder is much smaller. The tablet icon on messages another tablet sent no longer goes missing.
Fixed a crash when opening a video that had been downloaded ahead.
Since the last update: bubbles stop at about three quarters of the width.

messageplus.notes:
A new Sync messages or Sync attachments now replaces the previous one instead of piling up in storage, and a repeat attachments sync only sends what is new (much faster).
Also since build 128: pictures stay available for every tablet, group texts someone else starts get their own group, no doubled messages, texts with line breaks are no longer lost, a text the carrier refuses shows Not sent, and blocking and muting work the same on the phone and the tablet.

messageplus_previous.notes:
Pictures you send from the tablet now stay available, so every tablet shows them (before, the picture was removed right after it was sent).
Also in this update (build 128): group texts someone else starts get their own group, no more doubled messages, texts with line breaks are no longer lost, a text the carrier refuses shows Not sent, blocking and muting work the same on the phone and the tablet, and a fast Sync messages / Sync attachments with progress in percent.

tablet2.notes:
Fixes messages showing twice after the phone's history sync, and makes opening the app with a large message history much faster (the cleanup of those copies no longer scans every message again and again).
Also in this copy: the Performance log (Settings > Performance log), and group texts from a new group start their own group.
